s.p.espaces.rg_d: Zokopa alendo, zofunikira zazinthu, kukhazikitsidwa kwa bizinesi, malo ogwiritsira ntchito ndalama: mabungwe akuluakulu adziko lililonse.
s.p.espaces.rg_sub: Malamulo amasinthidwa nthawi zambiri: ONE WORLD samawasindikiza, amatsegula masamba ovomerezeka aposachedwa, kenako mumawawerenga m'chilankhulo chanu.
s.p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): kwa zinthu ndi nchito, zilolezo, misonkho, malamulo ndi njira patsamba limodzi
s.p.espaces.rg_g2: Mapu a Kupezeka kwa Msika (ITC): zofunikira zachikhalidwe ndi malamulo ochokera
s.p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): zikhalidwe, zolemba ndi malamulo a zaumoyo omwe dziko lino limakhazikitsa kwa zinthu
s.p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: malonda ndi EU komanso kuchokera ku EU, gawo ndi gawo
s.p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: code ya katundu ndi zilolezo polowa ku EU
s.p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): kukhazikitsa bizinesi, ndalama, malonda apadziko lonse lapansi, dziko ndi dziko
s.p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): onetsetsani kuti malowa sanalengedwe ndi woyang'anira pambuyo poti avomereza ndalama
s.p.espaces.rg_note: Masamba amatsegulidwa m'zinenero zawo: yesani kutanthauzira kwa browser yanu, kapena « Kumvetsa fayilo » ya fayilo.Ngati muli ndi lamulo lofunika kwambiri, funsani munthu wodziwa bwino za dzikolo.
s.p.espaces.cu_d: Zofunikira, zidziwitso, Incoterms, zida zaulere zovomerezeka, otumiza ndi oyendetsa.
s.p.espaces.cu_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD siyitumiza zolemba za katundu: wogulitsa katundu yemwe ali ndi chilolezo (wotumizira katundu) angachite izi kwa inu.
s.p.espaces.cu_t1: Mapaketi a Market Access (ITC, UN-WTO): ntchito ndi malamulo kwa pafupifupi dziko lililonse
s.p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (Union Europe): zilolezo, ndalama, malamulo ochokera, step by step
s.p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: code ya katundu (code HS) ndi zilolezo polowa ku Ulaya
s.p.espaces.cu_t4: Malamulo a French: EORI, chitsimikizo, simulators
s.p.espaces.cu_d3: Document yonyamula: chilolezo chonyamula (nyanja), chilolezo cha ndege (ndege), CMR (njira)
s.p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (mabizinesi omwe amatumiza kapena kutumiza kunja m'mayiko a EU)
s.p.espaces.cu_d6: Kutengera mtundu wa zinthu: chitsimikizo cha zaumoyo kapena zomera, chilolezo, malamulo a CE
s.p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: wogula amasamalira zonse kuchokera ku fakitale ya wogulitsa.
s.p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: wogulitsa amapatsa zinthu zovomerezeka kutumiza kunja kwa wogula.
s.p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: wogulitsa amayika pa njinga yamadzi; pambuyo pake, ziwopsezo ndi ndalama ndi za wogula.
s.p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: wogulitsa amalipira ndalama zonyamula katundu ndi chindapusa ku khomo lofika.
s.p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: wogulitsa amatumiza ku malo osankhidwa, wogula amalipira ndalama zowonjezera.
s.p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: wogulitsa amalipira zonse, kuphatikizapo malire a kutumiza.
s.p.espaces.cu_ban: Kuletsa kapena kuwongolera kulikonse: zitsulo, mankhwala osokoneza bongo, zinthu zosavomerezeka, mitundu yotetezedwa (CITES), zina mwa mankhwala.
s.p.espaces.cu_src: Zimachokera ku: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr. nthawi zonse onani malamulo oyenera azinthu zanu.
s.p.espaces.b_kind_mission: Ntchito yakutali kapena gig (kupatsa kapena kuyang'ana)
s.p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... sankhani ndalama za dziko lanu mukatumiza.
s.p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD siyitumiza ndalama zokhazokha ndipo imapeza chilichonse kuchokera kuzinthuzi: mumayerekezera pano, kenako mutumizira ndi ntchito yomwe mwasankha.
s.p.espaces.mt_wb: Kutumiza mtengo padziko lonse lapansi (World Bank): mtengo woyenera wotumizira ndalama, dziko ndi dziko, ntchito ndi ntchito
s.p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Kutumiza ndalama m'mayiko ambiri, kutumiza banki, wallet ya foni yam'manja
s.p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Kutumiza ndalama, kutumiza banki, wallet ya foni yam'manja
s.p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Kusinthanitsa banki pa mtengo wa malonda, ndalama zikuwonetsedwa pamaso inu kutumiza
s.p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Kusinthanitsa banki, wallet ya foni yam'manja, kulandira ndalama
s.p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, kutumiza banki, ndalama pick-up
s.p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Kutumiza ku wallet ya foni yam'manja kapena akaunti ya banki
s.p.espaces.mt_k1: Taganizirani ndalama zonse zomwe mwalandira: malipiro + mtengo wa kusinthana kwa ndalama. Mtengo woipa kuposa mtengo wa msika ndi mtengo wosadziwika.
s.p.espaces.mt_k2: Sankhani momwe munthu amalandira: ndalama, akaunti ya banki kapena wallet ya foni yam'manja (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
s.p.espaces.mt_k3: Makalata a ID nthawi zambiri amafunikira, osati kutumiza komanso kulandira.
s.p.espaces.mt_k4: Musatumize ndalama kwa munthu amene munamukumana pa intaneti, kapena kuti "mutsegule" mphotho, mphatso, ngongole kapena visa: nthawi zonse zimakhala zowopsa.
s.p.espaces.mt_note: Zosintha za ntchito ndi mtengo: nthawi zonse onani patsamba lawo pamene mutumiza.
s.p.espaces.ds_d: Kugulitsa popanda ndalama: kupeza wogulitsa, kugwira ntchito pa mtengo wabwino, kukhala m'chigawo cha malamulo.
s.p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping imatanthauza kugulitsa zinthu zomwe wogulitsa amatumiza mwachindunji kwa kasitomala wanu.Kuyamba ndi kosavuta, koma mumakhala ndi udindo wogulitsa.
s.p.espaces.ds_s1: Sankhani chinthu chomwe chimaloledwa m'dziko la kasitomala wanu: palibe zinthu zofalitsidwanso, palibe zinthu zomwe zili pansi pa malamulo popanda chilolezo.
s.p.espaces.ds_s2: Pezani wogulitsa ("Wholesale / supplier" listings pano kapena ma platforms a wholesale) ndi kugula chitsanzo pambuyo pogulitsa.
s.p.espaces.ds_s3: Pezani mtengo woyenera: chinthu, kutumiza, malire, VAT ya dziko la kasitomala, ndalama za ngongole ndi zobwezeredwa.
s.p.espaces.ds_s5: Kulembetsa ntchito yanu: khalidwe la kampani, VAT ndi misonkho malinga ndi dziko lanu (onani malamulo a malonda).
s.p.espaces.ds_s6: Kulemekeza ufulu wa ogula: mtengo wodziwika bwino kuphatikizapo ndalama, ufulu wobwezera, chitsimikizo, kuteteza deta.
s.p.espaces.ds_w1: Wogulitsa yemwe akufuna kulipira kwathunthu potumiza ndalama zosatetezedwa kapena mu cryptocurrency.
s.p.espaces.ds_w2: Maphunziro olipira omwe amalonjeza kuti akuthandizeni kukhala ndi ndalama mofulumira.
s.p.espaces.ds_w3: Zithunzi zosavomerezeka ndi zotsutsana: ndizolakwika komanso zimawononga.
s.p.espaces.ds_w4: M'mayiko a Ulaya, ndalama zochokera kunja kwa EU zimalipira VAT kuyambira pa euro yoyamba.
s.p.espaces.ds_plat: Ma platforms ogulitsa malonda (apadera, osagwirizana ndi 24/24 ONE WORLD)
s.p.espaces.bo_d: Maindex, mitengo, ndalama, zinthu ndi cryptocurrencies kuchokera padziko lonse lapansi, ndi ma charts.

s.p.espaces.bo_priv: Podina batani ili, mtengo umatulutsidwa kuchokera ku TradingView (ntchito yakunja), m'dera lodziyimira palokha lomwe silingathe kulowa mu akaunti yanu.

s.p.papier.title: 📄 Kumvetsa buku
s.p.papier.sub: Tengani chithunzi cha kalata, chilolezo cha mankhwala, fomu kapena lamulo: lolani anthu ena kuti aziwerenga m'chilankhulo chanu.
s.p.papier.private: Fomu imakhala pafoni yanu, koma mawu omwe adawerengedwa okha ndi omwe amatumizidwa ku ntchito yomasulira yaulere.
s.p.papier.first: Nthawi yoyamba kwa zinenero izi: foni imatsitsa deta yake yowerenga (MB zingapo).
s.p.papier.none: Palibe malemba opezeka. Tengani chithunzichonso, mozungulira ndi kuwala kwambiri.
s.p.papier.e_lib: Kuwerenga sikunayambe: nthawi yoyamba imafuna kulumikizana ndi intaneti. Pitaninso pamene mukugwirizana.
s.p.papier.e_tr: Kumasulira kukanatha (kulumikizana kapena malire a tsiku). Pitaninso.
s.p.papier.warn: Kutanthauzira kwa makina: ngati muli ndi chidziwitso chofunika (chigamulo cha khoti, chitsimikizo cha thanzi, ndalama, chilolezo chokhalamo), onetsetsani kuti munthu amene mumamukhulupirira kapena gulu lina linamuyang'ana.
